notes: The app now fits every phone screen — the top is no longer cut off by the notch or status bar.
Back button added to the top bar: go back to the previous screen or straight home from any page.
The Android back key also navigates back through the app properly.
The floating pen is removed when you close the app — it only stays while the app is open.
App updates: you'll see an "Update available" notice with the full list of changes and can install right from the app.
More reliable up-to-date version info in Settings with a manual 'Check for app update'.
Only one floating pen, and the quick-capture window follows the pen wherever you drag it.
Cleaner, roomier interface with Font Awesome icons instead of emojis.
